transcript: Kitchen small appliance branch circuit update for Brenda Nelson, 334 Pinehurst Road. Replaced three old ungrounded standard receptacles with twenty-amp tamper-resistant GFCI outlets. Added one dual-function AFCI/GFCI breaker in the panel. Tested trip thresholds and labeled all protected downstream outlets. Labor was two hours flat. GFCI receptacles are twenty-two bucks each on the rate sheet.

expected.job_summary: Kitchen branch circuit update with 20A GFCI outlets and AFCI breaker
expected.notes: Tested trip thresholds and labeled downstream outlets.
